findings.description: The Total bar uses margin-top:-46px, so it sits over the last expense row (Project dinner, $93.25) on desktop and hides that row's content. On a 360px phone the same overlap cuts off the amount of the last row.
repro: Sign in as editor-eab4 at 1280px width
Scroll the table to the bottom: the Total box covers the 'Project dinner' row
Repeat at 360px as viewer-d51d: the 'Project dinner' amount is hidden under the Total box

findings.description: A global rule sets outline:none on *:focus and *:focus-visible, so keyboard users get no visible focus indicator on links, buttons, selects and inputs. Tabbing to the Apply button shows no outline.
repro: Press Tab twice to reach the Apply button
Observe that no focus ring is drawn (computed outline-style is none)

findings.description: The table shows an 'Actions' column header for viewers, but every cell in that column is empty because viewers cannot edit or delete.
repro: Look at the rightmost table column: header 'Actions' with empty cells

notes: Tested login, the expenses list and total (sum checks out at $399.99), desktop and 360px layouts for both roles, focus styling, and the add-expense form markup. Did not test edit/delete flows, the category filter results, touch targets, or screen-reader behaviour in depth, given the time budget.

cost.notes: estimate from 24320 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0002-$0.0029
